## CHAPTER XXX.

### On the Reign of the Sun.

Now you approach the end of your work, and you have nearly finished your business; now everything appears like the finest gold <note>original: "auri obryzi," referring to pure, refined gold</note>, and the <term>virgin's milk</term> <gloss>the alchemical solvent used to moisten the matter</gloss>, with which you soak this material, turns very yellow. Now return immortal thanks to God, the giver of all good things, who has led the work this far; pray to Him as a suppliant that He may rule your counsel from now on, lest by chance you lose the almost completed work entirely by striving to hurry it. Consider now that you have waited for almost seven months, and it would not be sane to annihilate everything in a single little hour. Therefore, be very cautious, all the more so as you are closer to perfection. Truly, if you proceed cautiously, these notable things will occur to you: first you will observe a certain yellow sweat on the body, and finally yellow vapors as the body settles, tinted with violet and sometimes with a dark purple.
